name: Banjo-Kazooie Double Pack
summary: The Banjo-Kazooie Double Pack cartridge for Evercade brings Rare's classic Nintendo 64 platformers Banjo-Kazooie and Banjo-Tooie to Evercade in newly enhanced native ports, featuring save states, refined controls, improved camera options, a music player with previously unreleased tracks, a cheat menu, and — exclusive to this release — the previously unreleased Banjo-Tooie multiplayer mode "Bottles' Revenge".
